verdicts.title: Birational automorphism groups of projective varieties of Picard number two
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: We slightly extend a result of Oguiso on birational or automorphism groups (resp. of Lazić - Peternell on Morrison-Kawamata cone conjecture) from Calabi-Yau manifolds of Picard number two to arbitrary singular varieties X (resp. to klt Calabi-Yau pairs in broad sense) of Picard number two. When X has only klt singularities and is not a complex torus, we show that either Aut(X) is almost cyclic, or it has only finitely many connected components.
verdicts.judge_reasoning: The abstract concerns birational automorphism groups of projective varieties of Picard number two and Calabi-Yau pairs — it makes no mention of CNF formulas, resolution proof width, or any connection to proof complexity, so it shares only the vocabulary 'birational' with the conjecture.

verdicts.title: Singular del Pezzo fibrations and birational rigidity
verdicts.abstract_excerpt: A known conjecture of Grinenko in birational geometry asserts that a Mori fibre space with the structure of del Pezzo fibration of low degree is birationally rigid if and only if its anticanonical class is an interior point in the cone of mobile divisors. The conjecture is proved to be true for smooth models (with a generality assumption for degree 3). It is speculated that the conjecture holds for, at least, Gorenstein models in degree 1 and 2.
